no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

response: {"headline": "AIM-HIGH (3,414 patients, median follow-up 32 months) was stopped early for futility after the DSMB found less than a 1 in 10,000 chance of ever showing significant benefit; the trial's primary target biomarker HDL-C is not causal for coronary artery disease, so the failure was predictable.", "summary": "The AIM-HIGH trial randomized 3,414 patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and optimally treated LDL-C (baseline 71 mg/dL on simvastatin) to extended-release niacin or placebo, with baseline HDL-C of 34.9 mg/dL and triglycerides of 161 mg/dL. The primary endpoint was a composite of coronary heart disease death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, ischemic stroke, hospitalization for acute coronary syndrome, or symptom-driven coronary or cerebral revascularization. The trial was designed for 850 events with 85% power to detect a 25% relative risk reduction based on the HDL-C hypothesis, but it was stopped early on 2011-05-26 because the DSMB judged the chance of eventual benefit to be less than 1 in 10,000. No observed hazard ratio or confidence interval has been reported, and no placebo-adjusted on-treatment biomarker changes from AIM-HIGH itself are available, so the effect size remains unquantified.
